messages.content:
You are the planner of Cobble. Turn the approved specification into an implementation plan for small coding agents.
Reply with ONLY one JSON object: no commentary, no Markdown outside an optional ```json fence.
Schema:
{"milestones": [{"id": "M1", "title": "..."}], "tasks": [{"id": "T-001", "title": "...", "milestone": "M1", "depends_on": [], "files": ["app/main.py", "tests/test_main.py"], "acceptance": ["..."], "tests": "tests/test_main.py", "size": "S", "role": "backend"}]}
Rules:
- Use at most 3 milestones (ids M1, M2, ...), each one a demo the user can try. Tasks are numbered T-001, T-002, ...
- "size" is "S" or "M", never "L": split anything bigger into several tasks.
- "role" is one of backend, frontend, fullstack, devops, docs.
- "acceptance": one to four testable criteria per task (an observable behaviour, for example an HTTP status or a visible result). Write them in English.
- "tests": the path of the test file, written BEFORE the implementation, so it must also be listed in "files".
- "files": relative paths only (backend in app/, tests in tests/, front end in web/), never absolute and never containing '..'. Keep tasks from sharing files when possible.
- "depends_on": ids of tasks that must be finished first; no cycles; every id must exist.
- Write milestone and task titles in French, the user's language.
- The only project template available is a FastAPI backend (Python) with a simple web front end. Never propose another stack.

Approved specification:

# Plan retry scenario: retry

A specification used only to test plan retries.

Return the JSON plan now.

```json
{
  "milestones": [
    {
      "id": "M1",
      "title": "API des tâches"
    },
    {
      "id": "M2",
      "title": "Page web"
    },
    {
      "id": "M3",
      "title": "Finitions et livraison"
    }
  ],
  "tasks": [
    {
      "id": "T-001",
      "title": "Squelette de l'application et point de santé",
      "milestone": "M1",
      "depends_on": [],
      "files": [
        "app/main.py",
        "tests/test_health.py"
      ],
      "acceptance": [
        "GET /api/health returns 200 with {\"status\": \"ok\"}"
      ],
      "tests": "tests/test_health.py",
      "size": "S",
      "role": "backend"
    },
    {
      "id": "T-002",
      "title": "Modèle et stockage des tâches",
      "milestone": "M1",
      "depends_on": [
        "T-001"
      ],
      "files": [
        "app/models.py",
        "app/db.py",
        "tests/test_models.py"
      ],
      "acceptance": [
        "A todo has an id, a title and a done flag that is false by default",
        "A stored todo can be read back with the same values"
      ],
      "tests": "tests/test_models.py",
      "size": "S",
      "role": "backend"
    },
    {
      "id": "T-003",
      "title": "Créer et lister les tâches",
      "milestone": "M1",
      "depends_on": [
        "T-002"
      ],
      "files": [
        "app/api/todos.py",
        "tests/test_todos_create_list.py"
      ],
      "acceptance": [],
      "tests": "tests/test_todos_create_list.py",
      "size": "M",
      "role": "backend"
    },
    {
      "id": "T-004",
      "title": "Cocher et supprimer une tâche",
      "milestone": "M1",
      "depends_on": [
        "T-002"
      ],
      "files": [
        "app/api/todo_item.py",
        "tests/test_todo_item.py"
      ],
      "acceptance": [
        "PATCH /api/todos/{id} with done=true returns 200 and the todo marked done",
        "DELETE /api/todos/{id} returns 204 and the todo is no longer listed",
        "PATCH or DELETE on an unknown id returns 404"
      ],
      "tests": "tests/test_todo_item.py",
      "size": "L",
      "role": "backend"
    },
    {
      "id": "T-005",
      "title": "Squelette de la page web",
      "milestone": "M2",
      "depends_on": [
        "T-001"
      ],
      "files": [
        "app/api/web.py",
        "frontend/index.html",
        "frontend/vite.config.ts",
        "frontend/src/App.tsx",
        "frontend/src/App.test.tsx",
        "tests/test_web_served.py"
      ],
      "acceptance": [
        "GET / returns 200 with the HTML page",
        "The page contains the application title"
      ],
      "tests": "tests/test_web_served.py",
      "size": "S",
      "role": "frontend"
    },
    {
      "id": "T-006",
      "title": "Afficher la liste des tâches",
      "milestone": "M2",
      "depends_on": [
        "T-003",
        "T-005"
      ],
      "files": [
        "frontend/src/api.ts",
        "frontend/src/TodoList.tsx",
        "frontend/src/App.tsx",
        "frontend/src/list.test.tsx"
      ],
      "acceptance": [
        "The page shows the todos returned by GET /api/todos",
        "With no todo, the page shows an empty-state message"
      ],
      "tests": "frontend/src/list.test.tsx",
      "size": "S",
      "role": "frontend"
    },
    {
      "id": "T-007",
      "title": "Formulaire d'ajout",
      "milestone": "M2",
      "depends_on": [
        "T-006"
      ],
      "files": [
        "frontend/src/AddTodo.tsx",
        "frontend/src/api.ts",
        "frontend/src/App.tsx",
        "frontend/src/add.test.tsx"
      ],
      "acceptance": [
        "Submitting the form with a title creates the todo and shows it in the list",
        "Submitting an empty title sends no request and shows an error message"
      ],
      "tests": "frontend/src/add.test.tsx",
      "size": "M",
      "role": "frontend"
    },
    {
      "id": "T-008",
      "title": "Cocher et supprimer depuis la page",
      "milestone": "M2",
      "depends_on": [
        "T-004",
        "T-007"
      ],
      "files": [
        "frontend/src/TodoList.tsx",
        "frontend/src/api.ts",
        "frontend/src/App.tsx",
        "frontend/src/actions.test.tsx"
      ],
      "acceptance": [
        "Clicking a checkbox toggles the todo and keeps the new state after a reload",
        "Clicking the delete button removes the todo from the list"
      ],
      "tests": "frontend/src/actions.test.tsx",
      "size": "S",
      "role": "frontend"
    },
    {
      "id": "T-009",
      "title": "Conserver les données après redémarrage",
      "milestone": "M3",
      "depends_on": [
        "T-003"
      ],
      "files": [
        "app/config.py",
        "app/db.py",
        ".gitignore",
        "tests/test_persistence.py"
      ],
      "acceptance": [
        "Todos created before an application restart are still listed after it"
      ],
      "tests": "tests/test_persistence.py",
      "size": "S",
      "role": "backend"
    },
    {
      "id": "T-010",
      "title": "Mise en page pour téléphone",
      "milestone": "M3",
      "depends_on": [
        "T-006"
      ],
      "files": [
        "frontend/src/style.css",
        "frontend/src/main.tsx",
        "frontend/vite.config.ts",
        "frontend/src/style.test.ts"
      ],
      "acceptance": [
        "At a width of 375 px the page has no horizontal scroll",
        "Buttons and checkboxes are at least 44 px tall"
      ],
      "tests": "frontend/src/style.test.ts",
      "size": "S",
      "role": "frontend"
    },
    {
      "id": "T-011",
      "title": "Documentation d'utilisation",
      "milestone": "M3",
      "depends_on": [
        "T-008",
        "T-009"
      ],
      "files": [
        "README.md",
        "tests/test_docs.py"
      ],
      "acceptance": [
        "The README explains how to start the application and how to run the tests"
      ],
      "tests": "tests/test_docs.py",
      "size": "S",
      "role": "docs"
    }
  ]
}
```

Your plan was rejected for these reasons:
- tasks[2].acceptance: at least one acceptance criterion is required
- tasks[3].size: must be 'S' or 'M' (split any larger task into smaller ones)
Return the corrected JSON plan only.
